versions.changelog:
Initial release of meixin-meeting-assistant:

- Automatically transcribes meeting audio using Fun-ASR, supporting large files (100MB+/5hr).
- Converts colloquial business terms to standard healthcare/insurance industry terminology.
- Attributes meeting remarks to specific speakers based on background and voice features.
- Outputs structured meeting minutes in compliance with industry standards (non-tabular).
- Integrates with knowledge base: links to previous meetings, related documents, and tracks action items.
